name: Shutterflash Kamera
desc:
A custom-built Kamera equipped with Lepine-Pauline's latest "Shutterflash" lens.
Its intricate inner workings can freeze the flutter of a bird's wings or the flash of a swordsman's strike in an instant. It captures the swiftest motion and preserves the most precious scenes, including every shining moment worth remembering when you reunite with friends.

value.text: Obtained during the event "Shutterflash Memory Hunt" in Version Luna IV (expires after the Event ends)
